questions.label: Morning together
questions.prompt: A slow morning together. What feels most like home?

options.label: Tea and a long walk with no phones
Coffee and a shared to-do list
Coffee and a long inside-joke warmup
Tea and a podcast you keep pausing to discuss

questions.label: Disagreement
questions.prompt: When you disagree, what do you most want from them?

options.label: Soft hands, a softer voice
Steady presence, no exit threats
A well-timed joke that breaks the heat
A real question about why I think that
Tiny corner table, candle, just us
Big table, friends everywhere, second rounds
Quiet tasting menu, chef's choice, no menu
Cooking it together, music, flour on the counter

questions.label: Empty weekend
questions.prompt: An empty weekend. What does it become?

options.label: A new neighborhood, no plan, just wander
A side project, side by side, headphones optional
A long nap, a slow brunch, then nothing
A house full of friends, someone brings a guitar

questions.label: Their ambition
questions.prompt: What ambition in them do you find most attractive?

options.label: Building something that outlives them
Always learning, always curious
Leading teams, making hard calls without flinching
Caring for the people closest to them

questions.label: They had a hard day
questions.prompt: They had a rough day. What do you do?

options.label: Hold them, not say much, just be there
Help them actually fix the thing
Distract them with something silly until the tension lifts
Ask good questions until they hear themselves

questions.label: Big trip
questions.prompt: Two weeks of travel together. What's the dream?

options.label: Two cities, slow, no checklist
Last-minute tickets, see where the bus goes
Everything booked, every day has a plan
Visiting people we know in every stop

questions.label: Sense of humor
questions.prompt: The kind of humor that wins you over is...

options.label: Dry, deadpan, almost too quiet
Absurd, silly, the dumber the better
Fast banter, callbacks, sharp timing
Warm teasing that we'd both laugh at

questions.label: Loyalty test
questions.prompt: What shows you they're loyal over time?

options.label: They remember the small things you mentioned once
They defend you when you aren't in the room
They stay when things are hard, not just when they're good
They show up. Consistently. Without being asked

questions.label: Curiosity
questions.prompt: What kind of curiosity do you most want to share?

options.label: Big ideas, late nights, half-formed theories
How people work, why they do what they do
Places, languages, food, the wider world
Hands-on skills, building, crafting, making

archetypes.label: The Cozy Companion
archetypes.tagline: Warm, steady, and grounded in the everyday stuff.
archetypes.blind-spot: Stability can curdle into routine if no one shakes things up.

archetypes.label: The Co-Conspirator
archetypes.tagline: Loyal, ambitious, and ready to build something together.
archetypes.blind-spot: All-in loyalty can blur the lines when compromise is needed.

archetypes.label: The Jester
archetypes.tagline: Quick, witty, and the kind of funny that makes a Tuesday feel like a holiday.
archetypes.blind-spot: Humor can dodge the harder conversations when they actually need to happen.

archetypes.label: The Curious Stranger
archetypes.tagline: Always asking, always wandering, always bringing the world home.
archetypes.blind-spot: Novelty can crowd out the deep, slow work of staying close.

archetypes.label: The Steady Flame
archetypes.tagline: Warm, loyal, and reliably present in good seasons and hard ones.
archetypes.blind-spot: Showing up for others can crowd out showing up for yourself.

archetypes.label: The Renaissance Match
archetypes.tagline: Curious, warm, and full of side projects you want to hear about.
archetypes.blind-spot: Spreading wide can leave the everyday a little thin.
